## kb_to_source
- Sentence sweep of the 23 documents of this tree and the base documents: every normative claim has a source home, with one exception class:
  - **K1 (scope narrowed to the current enrollment type).** The source scopes the plan to "the open balance of a Pre-K tuition account" and, through its closing-account factor, explicitly to "a plan on an enrollment whose move to Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) took effect …"; the reversal and waiver rules carry no type scope at all, and the eligibility credit is posted on an enrollment that is moving (or has moved) to State-Eligible. The corpus instead scopes each of these policies to the type "Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based)":
    - `prek_tuition_payment_plan` (Terms): "The plan applies to a Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) enrollment of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions." — an "applies to" restriction the source does not have, which on its face excludes the case `payment_plan_closing_account_down_payment` prices ("a payment plan on an enrollment that has moved from Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) to Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible)") and this task's record (variant_name "Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible)", transfer_effective_date 2027-01-01).
    - The same label in the plan's computation and factor documents: `payment_plan_first_installment_amount` ("On a Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) enrollment … the first installment of a payment plan is figured as follows"), `payment_plan_down_payment_terms` ("a Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) payment plan's first installment"), `payment_plan_length_schedule`, `payment_plan_household_size_installments`, `payment_plan_meal_status_extra_installments`, `payment_plan_paper_payment_down_addition`.
    - The same label on the reversal and waiver, whose source rules have no type scope: `late_fee_reversal_after_eligibility_credit`, `late_fee_reversal_amount`, `credited_share_late_fee_reversal`, `late_fee_reversal_account_standing_addition`, `late_fee_reversal_household_size_addition`, `late_fee_reversal_payment_method_addition`, `eligibility_transition_late_fee_waiver`, `late_fee_waiver_amount`, `late_fee_standing_part_for_waivers`, `late_fee_waiver_courtesy_schedule`, `late_fee_waiver_household_size_addition`, `late_fee_waiver_payment_method_addition`; and on the basis-month credit documents (`basis_month_credit_amount`, `basis_month_proration_by_meal_status`, `basis_month_credit_arrears_addition`, `basis_month_credit_household_size_addition`, `basis_month_credit_payment_method_addition`), where it is weaker (it can be read as the enrollment as it stood before the move, which the hub describes).
    - Effect: at the level of entailment the visible materials state two scopes for the plan (Tuition-Based only, versus moved-to-State-Eligible enrollments included); the reading that settles this task rests on the closing-account schedule and the move rule outweighing the hub's own scope sentence. The blind pass reached the gold answer, so this is not KB-RUNTIME, but the scope is rewritten relative to the source across the whole domain of this tree (every world where the move precedes these writes, as here).
